title: HERMES Shared-Stream Recovery Decision Envelope v1
description: Immutable, side-effect-free decision produced by the shared-stream recovery-authority pure core. INERT. A future executor consumes ONLY a decision whose action == RECONNECT_AUTHORISED; every other action is advisory or throttled. EXTENDED (WO-HELM-HERMES-SHARED-STREAM-RECOVERY-PHASE1-PURE-DECISION-CORE-IMPLEMENTATION-0001) to ALSO validate the PRODUCTION-owned envelope from utils/hermes_shared_stream_recovery_v1.py, additively and BACK-COMPATIBLY with the audited design prototype (design/shared_stream_recovery_contract_v1.py). The prototype uses decision_version/transport_authority/emergency_bypass/stale_instruments; the production core uses contract_version/envelope_version/reconnect_authorised/emergency_bypass_eligible/stale_governed_instruments. Both shapes validate against this schema. Original WO: WO-HELM-HERMES-SHARED-STREAM-RECOVERY-CONTRACT-DESIGN-0001.

envelope_version.description: PRODUCTION envelope version. Unsupported versions fail safely on decode.

decision_id.description: Deterministic sha256[:16] over the canonical input (production) / decided fields (prototype), OR a supplied correlation id. No hidden randomness / Date.now.

evaluated_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant of evaluation, or a fail-safe sentinel (e.g. INVALID_CLOCK / INVALID_CONTRACT) when a guard fired.

transport_state.description: Transport-authority state machine state. Derived PURELY from transport signals, never from per-instrument freshness.

heartbeat_age_s.description: Age of last transport heartbeat/price (adapter last_tick_at). null when heartbeat truth is unavailable -> fail closed.

shared_progress_state.description: Shared-stream progress proxy (heartbeat freshness, bumped by ANY instrument's price or a heartbeat).

expected_flow_instruments.description: Instruments governed-OPEN + past reopening grace => data expected right now.

stale_instruments.description: PROTOTYPE field: non-governed-closed stale instruments (fail-loud, visible).

stale_governed_instruments.description: PRODUCTION field: non-governed-closed stale instruments (fail-loud, visible).

unvalidated_stale_instruments.description: PROTOTYPE field name for stale instruments lacking a validated schedule.

stale_unvalidated_instruments.description: Stale instruments lacking a validated schedule (e.g. WTICO_USD, SPX500_USD). Fail-loud health YES; transport vote NO (alone).

reconnect_authorised.description: PRODUCTION: True only when action == RECONNECT_AUTHORISED (executor may act now).

emergency_bypass_eligible.description: PRODUCTION: True only for genuine provider/socket/auth/shared faults (narrow, reason-coded). Never caller-settable.

emergency_bypass_reason.description: PRODUCTION: the genuine-fault reason code that opens the narrow limiter bypass, else null.

adapter_bounding_required.description: PRODUCTION: True when a Phase-2 executor MUST bound the (bypassing) reconnect callbacks/backoff.

action.description: The single decided action. Executor obeys ONLY RECONNECT_AUTHORISED.

available.description: False models limiter store unreadable (Redis/SQL down) -> fail closed = exhausted for non-emergency authority.

config_version.description: Governed market-hours config version in force (3 on the canonical base).
